# Isar — local database (plan, 2026-09-25)

## Context

School requirement: a local database. Decided 2026-09-18: Isar holds what
never leaves the device (settings, scan history, cached yaku catalog);
progress stays Firestore's; the two never hold the same data. Decided
2026-09-24 after the toolchain spike (ROADMAP decisions log): Isar via
`isar_community` 3.3.2 with `dependency_overrides: analyzer: ^14.4.0`;
generator, suite and debug APK verified green; `Isar.open` on a device not
yet exercised (Task 0 here).

Decisions (brainstorming, 2026-09-24, user):
- **Scope: all three** — cached yaku catalog, scan history, settings limited
  to the theme mode (Système / Clair / Sombre). No other settings.
- **Scan history UI**: Profil stat « Tuiles maîtrisées » (handoff 18, distinct
  tiles scanned) that opens a plain list (tile, name, date). No new handoff
  screen invented, nothing added to the viewfinder.
- **Dependency**: `path_provider` approved (`getApplicationDocumentsDirectory`
  for the Isar directory).
- **Placement**: `lib/local/` holds only the open/injection provider;
  collections, repositories and screens live in their feature
  (`lib/yaku/`, `lib/scanner/`, new `lib/settings/`).

Verified in `isar_community-3.3.2/lib/src/`: `Isar.open(List<CollectionSchema>
schemas, {required String directory, String name, bool inspector = true, …})`
(`isar.dart:88`); `Future<T> writeTxn(Future<T> Function())` (`isar.dart:165`);
collection `put`, `putAll`, `clear`, `count`, `where()…watch(fireImmediately:)`
(`isar_collection.dart`); annotations `@collection`, `@Index()`,
`@enumerated` (ordinal by default), `@ignore`; entry file is
`package:isar_community/isar.dart` (not `isar_community.dart`). Id type `Id`,
`Isar.autoIncrement`. Verified at Task 0 (2026-09-25): `@enumerated` accepts
Flutter's `ThemeMode` (enum from another package); `settings_record.g.dart`
generated, analyzer clean.

Working mode unchanged: user writes `lib/`, Claude tutors/reviews, test-writer
writes tests, Claude does docs. Isar itself is never opened in unit tests
(native core): repositories are faked; the device pass (Task 7) is the
integration test.

## Layout

```
lib/local/isar_providers.dart              isarProvider = Provider<Isar>((_) => throw UnimplementedError(...)); overridden in main
lib/settings/settings_record.dart          @collection SettingsRecord { Id id = 0; @enumerated ThemeMode themeMode; }  (+ .g.dart)
lib/settings/settings_repository.dart      abstract: Future<ThemeMode> themeMode(); Future<void> setThemeMode(ThemeMode)
lib/settings/isar_settings_repository.dart IsarSettingsRepository(this._isar)
lib/settings/settings_providers.dart       settingsRepositoryProvider, themeModeProvider (AsyncNotifier<ThemeMode>)
lib/settings/settings_screen.dart          SettingsScreen at /settings: « Réglages », SegmentedButton Système / Clair / Sombre
lib/scanner/scan_record.dart               @collection ScanRecord { Id id = autoIncrement; String code; @Index() DateTime scannedAt; }
lib/scanner/scan_history_repository.dart   abstract: Future<void> add(Tile tile); Stream<List<ScanRecord>> watch()
lib/scanner/isar_scan_history_repository.dart
lib/scanner/scan_history_screen.dart       ScanHistoryScreen at /scanner/history: list rows tile + name + date
lib/yaku/yaku_record.dart                  @collection YakuRecord (every Yaku field, @enumerated YakuTier, List<String> tiles) + toYaku() / YakuRecord.fromYaku()
lib/yaku/yaku_cache_source.dart            abstract YakuCacheSource { Future<List<Yaku>> read(); Future<void> replace(List<Yaku>) }
lib/yaku/isar_yaku_cache_source.dart       IsarYakuCacheSource(this._isar)
lib/yaku/cached_yaku_repository.dart       CachedYakuRepository(this._remote, this._cache) implements YakuRepository
```

Modified: `lib/main.dart` (open Isar, override), `lib/app/app.dart`
(`themeMode:`), `lib/app/router.dart` (`/settings`, `/scanner/history`),
`lib/learning/lesson_path_screen.dart` (gear → `/settings`),
`lib/profile/profile_screen.dart` (third stat), `lib/scanner/scanner_providers.dart`
(`scanHistoryRepositoryProvider`, `scanHistoryProvider`, `masteredTilesProvider`,
`scan()` records a found tile), `lib/yaku/yaku_providers.dart`
(`yakuRepositoryProvider` → cached), `pubspec.yaml` (`path_provider`).

Isar objects are mutable classes with public fields (the generator needs
them), which is the one place the privacy rule bends; keep them dumb: no
logic, one mapping function each way, never exposed above the repository
except `ScanRecord` (the history screen reads `code` and `scannedAt`).

## Data flow

```
main():  final dir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
         final isar = await Isar.open([SettingsRecordSchema, ScanRecordSchema, YakuRecordSchema], directory: dir.path);
         runApp(ProviderScope(overrides: [isarProvider.overrideWithValue(isar)], child: TenpaiApp()));

Theme:   themeModeProvider.build() → repository.themeMode() (missing row → ThemeMode.system)
         MaterialApp.router(themeMode: ref.watch(themeModeProvider).value ?? ThemeMode.system)
         SettingsScreen → ref.read(themeModeProvider.notifier).set(mode) → repository.setThemeMode → state = AsyncData(mode)

History: ScanNotifier.scan(): found(tile) → try { await history.add(tile) } catch (e, s) { debugPrint } (never breaks the sheet)
         scanHistoryProvider = StreamProvider(repository.watch())      Isar: where().sortByScannedAtDesc().watch(fireImmediately: true)
         masteredTilesProvider = Provider<int>: records.map((r) => r.code).toSet().length
         Profil stat « Tuiles maîtrisées » → context.push('/scanner/history') → ScanHistoryScreen watches scanHistoryProvider

Catalog: CachedYakuRepository.catalog():
           try { final fresh = await _remote.catalog(); await _cache.replace(fresh); return fresh; }
           catch (e, s) { debugPrint; final cached = await _cache.read(); if (cached.isEmpty) rethrow; return cached; }
         network first, cache fallback: the Dex works offline after one success; the in-flight-Future caching of
         YakuRepositoryImpl stays inside the remote repository, untouched.
```

Writes go through `isar.writeTxn(() => collection.put(...))`; reads need no
transaction. `replace` = `clear()` + `putAll()` in one `writeTxn`.

## UI

- **SettingsScreen** (`/settings`, pushed from the path header gear, back
  arrow): `Scaffold`, title « Réglages » (`headlineSmall`), one card
  (`radiusCard`, `shadowSurface`) with label « Thème » (`labelMedium` mono
  caps, `mutedStrong`) and a `SegmentedButton<ThemeMode>` with segments
  « Système », « Clair », « Sombre »; `selected: {mode}`, `onSelectionChanged`
  → `set(first)`. While loading, the button is disabled (`onSelectionChanged:
  null`). Tokens only; French verbatim.
- **Profil**: third `_StatCard` « Tuiles maîtrisées » with
  `masteredTilesProvider`; wrapped in `InkWell` → `/scanner/history`.
- **ScanHistoryScreen** (`/scanner/history`, back arrow): title « Tuiles
  scannées », `ListView.builder` of rows: `TileWidget(size: .regular)`,
  `tileName` (`bodyLarge`), date `jj/mm/aaaa` (`labelMedium` mono,
  `mutedStrong`) built by hand (no `intl`). Empty state: « Aucune tuile
  scannée pour l'instant. » centred. Errors: `RetryWidget` with
  `ref.invalidate(scanHistoryProvider)`.
- Gear on `lesson_path_screen.dart:128`: `onPressed: () => context.push(AppRoutes.settings)`.

## Deviations to log (known before building)

Settings and history screens are not in the handoff (minimal, tokens only);
Isar never opened in unit tests (native core), covered by fakes and the
device pass; `analyzer` override in `pubspec.yaml` until the fork's generator
allows analyzer 14; « Tuiles maîtrisées » counts scanned tiles, not
lesson-learned ones (handoff 18 does not define it).

Added at handover (2026-09-25): a red five counts as its own tile in
« Tuiles maîtrisées » (by choice); Isar failures are `Error`s, so the two
best-effort writes catch `on Object`; the tier switch from ordinal to name
was checked on the emulator (offline Dex, tiers correct); `ThemeMode` stays stored by ordinal.
